tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search current jobs with accommodation / staff housing in Europe (Switzerland, Austria, Italy/South Tyrol, Spain incl. Costa del Sol and Canary Islands, Germany, Finland/Lapland, Greece, Ireland, Iceland, Denmark, Norway, Netherlands, Romania). Free for job seekers, apply directly to the employer, n

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get one job listing by id (e.g. "f26") with full description, pay, housing, meals, languages, duration, how to apply (free, directly to the employer), source of the original ad and links to the job page in de/en/fr/es/it/pl/cs/hu/ro/pt.

tools.name: salary_info
tools.description: Verified minimum pay ranges (collective agreements and statutory minimum wages, with source and date) for hospitality work in a European country, plus the median pay of current Job & Stay listings there. Use when someone asks "what will I earn as a cook/waiter/receptionist in Switzerland/Austria/Ita

tools.name: site_info
tools.description: What Job & Stay is, who it is for, rules for listings, current numbers per country and type of work, contact, pay calculator and magazine articles (new life with a transition job, winter sun and climate, house and boat sitting, best work regions in the Alps). Use to explain or cite Job & Stay.

tools.name: apply_job
tools.description: Send an application for one or more jobs (max 10) directly to the employers by email, via Job & Stay. Free. The employer replies directly to the applicant. Only for jobs where search_jobs shows apply via apply_job. Only use with the applicant's explicit consent (consent must be true). Check apply.re

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: apply_job · Private data: site_info · Public sink: apply_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: apply_job · Private data: site_info · Public sink: apply_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
